title: Nonnegative odd Fourier maximum
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer and let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to the signs. The maximum of zero and the largest Fourier coefficient of $f$ indexed by an odd-cardinality subset equals the nonnegative odd Fourier maximum of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to the signs
